response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced full-stack and web software engineer with strong TypeScript/Node.js/DLang background, but he has no evident experience in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, GPU/AI accelerator architecture, or low-level performance engineering for deep-learning workloads, which are the core requirements for this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured software engineering career (15+ years)
Demonstrated systems/low-latency work in DLang (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Dunnhumby
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and public speaking
concerns: No experience with SoC/IP modeling or chip architecture
No demonstrated background in AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture
Career focus is web/mobile/backend software, not hardware-software co-design or performance architecture for accelerators

key_factors.factor: Strong general software engineering seniority and systems experience
